cim: How to run your first Codex Security scan
cim_eredeti: How to run your first Codex Security scan
szoveg_eredeti: Get started with Codex Security, from installing the plugin to running your first scan. Learn how to select a repository, add context, review findings, and generate a patch. Then follow the fix into GitHub and see how to use the CLI to bring security scans into your automation workflows.
